# pcd_identity_group (Data Source)

Look up a group in PCD's Keystone identity service by name or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pcd_identity_group" "example" {
  name = "admins"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain_id` (String) Restrict the lookup to (and report) this domain.
- `group_id` (String) Look up the group by ID (takes precedence over name).
- `name` (String) Look up the group by name.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The group description.
- `id` (String) The group ID.
